items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Avery and Aaron Scott seemed to be your rhythm section for a while... focused on the core of your group, that rhythm section, so Avery Sharpe

ctx.x: I don’t know. Louis was because we went to Brazil and Sonny Rollins, all of us went with Louis, but Avery yes, they were very--
Yeah Avery knew what I was doing.

And also Avery was playing electric bass. Now I don’t have any recollection or any documentation of you playing any electrical instruments. Not expanding into even electric piano let alone synthesizer or any of that. So that seemed to be something that didn’t interest you.
